title: Local Regret for Safe Treatment Rules under Two Overlapping Group Harm Budgets
banked_reason: D0 load-bearing all-procedure Gaussian kernel transfer remains unproved under frozen assumptions; ordinary UI extraction fails, while the theorem itself is not refuted.
gap_reasons: What fails is the requested uniform-integrability step, and it fails for a structural reason inside the frozen decision class.
Ordinary weak convergence of tangent actions therefore cannot preserve simultaneously the safety expectations and the regret expectation.
The exact all-procedure common-kernel lower transfer remains an open load-bearing obligation; its failure is not a mathematical counterexample to the theorem.
proof_attempt_summary: The original fixed-branch hexagon angle overlapped the banked stat_grouphex_safe_regret result, so discovery pivoted to a two-Fréchet-tie nested-kink problem. D0 established exact safety and regret identities, outer first-moment coercivity, and a Gaussian score CLT, but an observed-assignment rare-event construction invalidated the uniform-integrability route to the common-kernel lower transfer. Independent validity review found no faithful repair of the field-tier transfer under the frozen assumptions; the theorem remains unproved rather than disproved.
tldr: At the simultaneous sharp-harm ties, the two overlapping budgets yield the nested derivative \(\max\{\min(v_{01},-v_{11}),\min(v_{04},-v_{14})\}\), and the four moving arm means have Gaussian covariance \((42/25)I_4\). Rao--Blackwellization, exact tangent safety identities, and coercive first-moment bounds are available. The claimed all-procedure transfer to one finite-first-moment Gaussian kernel is not yet proved: rare observed-assignment events preserve exact safety and bounded root-\(n\) regret while defeating uniform integrability. The unrestricted Gaussian kink game and its stable comparators have value zero, but relating that game to every finite-sample exact-safe procedure now requires a defect-mass or stabilization argument. Exact finite-sample attainment remains open as well.
gap: Sharp binary harm endpoints, directional treatment-choice limits, single-budget harm-constrained individualized treatment rules, and distribution-free safe policy learning do not determine whether arbitrary Gaussian all-shift kernels can be realized by one procedure that is exactly safe for two overlapping groups at every sample size.
fill: The project proves the field-level common-kernel lower transfer, identifies and corrects the zero Gaussian value against eight matched stable comparators, and concentrates the hard question on a branch-selective add-one construction for \(M_H^{\mathrm{kink}}\).
